arStrings.szText:
An ominous orb of pure Eldritch energy circles you damaging any enemy it touches for {c_random}{SF_23}{/c} Fire damage. {c_important}Doom Orb{/c} may launch itself at distant enemies before returning.{if:SF_2}

Kills or damage to Bosses empower the orb's damage by {c_number}[SF_22*100]%{/c}. After {c_number}[SF_21*100]%{/c}, the orb explodes dealing {c_random}[SF_24]{/c} Fire damage to nearby enemies before reforming {c_number}[SF_20]{/c} seconds later.{/if}
Unlocked at Coven's Favor Tier VII and purchased from an Altar of Witchcraft at the Tree of Whispers.

Kills or damage to Bosses empower the orb's damage by {c_number}[SF_22*100]%{/c}. After {c_number}[SF_21*100]%{/c}, the orb explodes dealing {c_random}[SF_24]{/c} Fire damage to nearby enemies before reforming {c_number}[SF_20]{/c} seconds later.
